restaurant_name: เมืองทองทันตแพทย์
text:
I've been coming here since I was a teenager. I've moved to other clinics a few times, but I always come back to this one. The male dentist is great; he's polite, gentle, and the prices aren't too expensive.
For dental work, all I need is a dentist who's polite, gentle, and reasonably priced, and a quick and efficient service. This place is the best for me. The only downside is the lack of parking, but you can usually find parking nearby; it's not that hard to find. I've always found a parking spot whenever I go.

text: I had my teeth cleaned (tartar removed) once, and the dentist gave excellent advice and was very patient. My mouth feels much cleaner now.
